expectations: Merge, decline or close a pull request
context: area: src/contracts/source-control.ts (read-only; writes need separate SourceControlWriter)
intent: Let the reviewer comment, approve and request changes from the file view and overview

decisions.decision: Separate SourceControlWriter contract with its own write-only HTTP layer, allowlist and registry map
decisions.why: Constitution VIII.3 and X.11 forbid a shared write-capable client

decisions.decision: Two-step preview/confirm API with a single-use token bound to action hash and head SHA, head re-read at both steps
decisions.why: X.11 requires a preview token; fixes commit-shown vs commit-applied

decisions.decision: In-flight lock, pending write_record intent and read-back after ambiguous failure
decisions.why: No platform comment API has an idempotency key

decisions.decision: Add listComments and myDecision to the read provider; identify tool-posted comments via stored platform ids
decisions.why: Comments are not read today and platforms have no tool marker
Survive restart and sign-in redirect; many drafts per session
decisions.rejected: Extend the single sessionStorage draft field

decisions.decision: Per-action reviewCapability {allowed, reason} instead of platform branching
decisions.why: FR-020 and VIII.2; platforms differ on request-changes and withdraw

decisions.decision: One-click send with expectedHead check and per-click requestId; no preview, confirmation token or drafts
decisions.why: User chose immediate posting over preview and confirm, and dropped drafts
decisions.rejected: Preview and confirm with single-use token; local drafts

concerns.note: plan-blocks.py failed (missing template parts), so no calls/code/states/screens blocks were added
Write scopes in contracts/writer.md are unverified against fixtures
Most route paths and data-testid values in contracts/ are proposed, not pinned by the spec
ADR 0003 is still Proposed; README and MVP 1.3 still say the product never writes
US3 and US4 carry only tests because their behaviour lives in shared Foundational components, a consequence of the one-owner-per-file rule
Foundational is large (30 tasks) and blocks all stories
src/server/routes.ts registration file name is inferred from the reader report, not opened
Constitution II.4 and X.11 amended to 3.0.0 (preview/confirm and token removed) on the user request; FR-017 (drafts) removed
Delete comment and Withdraw are now irreversible single clicks

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and contracts for review actions via a new SourceControlWriter and two-step confirm API
plan.key_finding: Comments and the reviewer decision are not read today, and the read HTTP layer refuses all writes, so both the read and write sides are new work

tasks.summary: 40 tasks in 7 phases: Setup, a 6-wave Foundational phase (contracts, tests, adapters, core, server, shared UI), one phase per story, Polish
tasks.key_finding: One-owner-per-file forces shared UI components into Foundational, so US3 and US4 are verification-only phases

approach: Add a separate SourceControlWriter (own write-only fetch, allowlist, per-platform adapters) behind a core preview/confirm service with a single-use token, an in-flight lock and read-back reconciliation. Extend the read provider with comments and the reviewer decision. Store drafts and an append-only write_record in SQLite, and copy the override dialog for the confirmation UI.
